privileged_info_for_vlm: The observer must be on Mars at 18.44 N, 77.45 E, altitude -2500m. The date is 2023-02-18 at 20:00 UTC. Atmosphere and Ground must be toggled OFF (usually 'A' and 'G' keys or bottom toolbar). Constellation lines (C), labels (V), and planet labels (P) must be ON. On this date/time from Jezero, Saturn is very low near the horizon/Sun and Earth is a morning/evening star depending on the specific hour, but both should be labeled in the simulation if searched.
